_about: Calculator slugs accepted from RECS (RECS docs/spec.md §10.8, FR-10.8.2). backend/config/recs.json and frontend/config/recs.json must be identical (frontend/config/recs.drift.test.ts). To add a calculator: add the slug to both files, add EN/FR labels (recs.calculator.<slug>), deploy, then tell RECS to turn Send on for it (.specify/specs/003-recs-import/quickstart.md §5).
